title: CliOutput
description: The format for all messages written to stdout by the CLI

oneOf.description: Data that is output at the end of a command.
Status update output as a command progresses.
Additional warnings, such as for an outdated Python dependency.

BrowserTestSpec.description:
In-browser test spec produced by the `tmc` exercise service: the script to
run in the client plus an optional error set when the build failed.

ClientUpdateData.description: The update data type for the progress reporter.

ConfigValue.description: A setting in a TmcConfig file.

CourseProgress.description:
The current user's progress across every exercise they can see in a course.
Course-level totals (awarded/available points, passed count, percentage) are
not sent separately; derive them by summing over `exercises`, guarding the
percentage against a zero total.

oneOf.description: megabytes

not_attempted.description:
Exercises never attempted because the batch stopped early on a permanent auth
failure (see `stopped_for_auth`). Empty unless that happened.

stopped_for_auth.description:
True if a mooc token refresh permanently failed partway through the batch,
leaving `not_attempted` non-empty.

name.description:
The name of the exercise to be shown to the user.
Does not necessarily match or even contain the directory name.

tests.description: Descriptions of the tests that will be run for this exercise.

ExercisePackagingConfiguration.description: Represents configuration based on which submission may be packaged.

exercise_file_paths.description: Exercise folders or files which are copied from exercise template or clone.

student_file_paths.description: Student folders or files which are copied from submission.

ExerciseProgress.description:
The current user's progress on a single exercise. The authoritative "passed"
signal is `completed`; `attempted` distinguishes "not started" from "started
but not passed".

attempted.description: `true` once the user has started or submitted the exercise.

completed.description: `true` once the exercise reached the `Completed` activity stage.

score_given.description:
Points awarded to the user; `0.0` when the user has no state for the
exercise. Can be fractional (partial credit).

score_maximum.description: The maximum points obtainable from the exercise; can be `0`.

ExerciseSlideSubmissionListItem.description:
A single past submission of the current user to an exercise. `id` is the
exercise-slide-submission id used to download or share the submission.

slide_submission_id.description: Identifies the slide submission; what downloading and sharing take.

task_submission_id.description: Identifies the task submission; what grading is polled for.

oneOf.description: The grading could not complete.
There is no grading process occurring; for example, the student has not yet made any submission.
Final Grade is pending, and it does require human intervention; if a Score value is present, it indicates the current value is partial and may be updated during the manual grading.
Final Grade is pending, but does not require manual intervention; if a Score value is present, it indicates the current value is partial and may be updated.
The grading process is completed; the score value, if any, represents the current Final Grade;
For all other errors
403 from server
Not logged in, detected either by no token or 401 from server
Failed to connect to the TMC server, likely due to no internet connection
Client out of date
Invalid token

The user is not enrolled on the course this exercise belongs to
(backend `message_key: "not_enrolled"`, HTTP 422)

A submitted file's retention window elapsed before the submission naming
it was accepted (backend `message_key: "upload_expired"`, HTTP 422). The
upload is retried once first, so this means the retry failed too.

A submission named a file that was never uploaded for that exercise by
that user (backend `message_key: "unknown_upload"`, HTTP 422). Indicates
a client bug or tampering, never a race.

LocalMoocExercise.description: MOOC exercise inside the projects directory.

exercise-slug.description:
The exercise's on-disk directory name, used as its slug when building a
workspace entry (mirrors the TMC slug); stable since names are unique per
course.

LocalTmcExercise.description: TMC eercise inside the projects directory.

ModelSolutionSpec.description:
Mirrors the `tmc` exercise service's `ModelSolutionSpec`
(`services/tmc/src/util/stateInterfaces.ts`). The backend forwards it once
the model solution may be revealed; the solution is an uploaded project
archive for both exercise types.

MoocClientUpdateData.description:
Per-exercise download progress, mirroring TMC's `ClientUpdateData`. Surfaced
by the CLI as a `mooc-client-update-data` status update; `id` is a [`Uuid`]
since mooc exercises are UUID-keyed.

MoocDeviceLogin.description:
The data attached to a `mooc-device-login` status update. Mirrors the
relevant fields of the RFC 8628 device authorization response.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the device/user codes expire.

user_code.description: The code the user enters (or confirms) on the verification page.

verification_uri.description: URL the user opens to enter the `user_code`.

verification_uri_complete.description: URL that already includes the `user_code`, if the server provided one.

exercise-id.description:
The requested exercise's id; results are keyed by it so callers can
correlate each download/skip/failure back to the exercise (not the internal
editor task id).

MoocOldSubmissionRestore.description: Outcome of restoring a past mooc submission.

oneOf.description: The submission's archive was overlaid on a fresh stub.

The host has no files for the submission, so nothing on disk was touched:
an exercise type with no files, or a service that declares no way to
enumerate its answers' files.

PasteResult.description: A shareable URL for a submission.

browser_test.description:
In-browser test config; omitted for editor exercises or when no script
was built.

RefreshData.description: Data from a finished course refresh.

RefreshExercise.description: An exercise from a finished course refresh.

RunResult.description: The result of running an exercise's test suite against a submission.

logs.description:
Logs from the test run.
The key may be an arbitrary string identifying the type of log.

status.description: The overall status of a test run.

testResults.description: Whether each test passed and which points were awarded.

RunStatus.description: The overall status of a test run.

oneOf.description: The submission and tests compiled and all tests passed.
The submission and tests compiled but some tests failed.
The submission or tests did not compile.
The submission compiled but testrun was interrupted.

For when no other status seems suitable, or the language plugin has
suffered an internal error.
The command was ran without fatal errors
An unexpected issue occurred during the command

StatusUpdate.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

StatusUpdate2.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

StatusUpdate3.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

StatusUpdate4.description: The format for all status updates. May contain some data.

oneOf.description:
Mooc's per-exercise download progress, mirroring `ClientUpdateData` for
mooc's UUID-keyed exercises.

Emitted once at the start of `mooc login`, before the CLI blocks polling:
carries the verification URL and user code the client shows the user to
complete the OAuth2 device authorization login.

StyleValidationResult.description: The result of a style check.

StyleValidationStrategy.description: Determines how style errors are handled.

Submission.description:
get /api/v8/courses/{course_id}/submissions
get /api/v8/courses/{course_id}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get /api/v8/courses/{course_id}/users/current/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/current/submissions
get /api/v8/org/{organization_slug}/courses/{course_name}/submissions
get /api/v8/org/{organization_slug}/courses/{course_name}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get /api/v8/org/{organization_slug}/courses/{course_name}/users/current/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/{user_id}/submissions
get api/v8/exercises/{exercise_id}/users/current/submissions

TestDesc.description: A description of an exercise's test case.

name.description:
The full name of the test.

If the language organises tests into suites or classes, it is customary
to name the test as "class_name.method_name".

points.description:
The list of point names that passing this test may give.

To obtain a point X, the user must pass all exercises that require point X.

TestResult.description: The result of a single test case.

points.description: List of points that were received from the exercise from passed tests.

TmcConfig.description: The main configuration file. A separate one is used for each client.

course_id.description:
The course the exercise belongs to, so a client can locate it without a
separate lookup or an enrolled-course scan.

extra_exercise_files.description:
A list of files or directories that will always be considered exercise files.
`extra_student_files` takes precedence if a file is both an extra student file and an extra exercise file.

extra_student_files.description: A list of files or directories that will always be considered student files.

fail_on_valgrind_error.description: If set, Valgrind errors will be considered test errors.

force_update.description: A list of files that should always be overwritten by updates even if they are student files.

minimum_python_version.description: If set, will cause an error telling the student to update their Python if their version is older than the minimum.

sandbox_image.description: Overrides the default sandbox image. e.g. `eu.gcr.io/moocfi-public/tmc-sandbox-python:latest`

submission_size_limit_mb.description: Overrides the default archive size limit (500 Mb).

tests_timeout_ms.description: If set, tests are forcibly stopped after this duration.

TmcStyleValidationResult.description: The result of a style check.

TmcStyleValidationStrategy.description: Determines how style errors are handled.
